description: T-2324: what happens to a table and its structured references when delete_row deletes sheet row 7, the last data row above the totals row. Table Sales on S!B3:C8 (header B3:C3 Region/Qty, data rows 4-7 Qty 1,2,4,8, totals row 8 with C8 =SUBTOTAL(109,Sales[Qty])); sheet F holds A1 =SUM(Sales[Qty]), A2 =ROWS(Sales), A3 =ROWS(Sales[#All]), A4 =ROW(Sales[#Headers]), A5 FORMULATEXT(A1), A6 =SUM(S!C4:C7) (a plain range for comparison), A7 FORMULATEXT(A6), A8 =COUNTA(Sales[Region]), A9 FORMULATEXT(A8), A10 =COLUMNS(Sales), A11 =COLUMN(Sales[Qty]), A12 FORMULATEXT(A11), A13 =Sales[[#Totals],[Qty]], A14 =ROW(Sales[#Totals]), A15 FORMULATEXT(A13).
